docs.text: COHRA1 Study Schema LinkML schema for defining data elements used in the COHRA1 study. URI: https://w3id.org/OHD/DFA-study/cohra1 Name: cohra1 Classes Class Description Slots Slot Description AGE The particpant's age at the time of the visit. AvoidanceAnticipatoryFear Sum of responses related to avoidance/anticipatory fear, including DF01, DF02, DF08, DF09, DF10, DF11, DF12, and DF13. demRace What is your race/ethnicity? DF21 Choose the appropriate number for each item to rate your FEAR OF PAIN in relation to each event: Breaking your arm. DF22 Choose the appropriate number for each item to rate your FEAR OF PAIN in relation to each event: Having a foot doctor remove a wart from your foot with a sharp instrument. DF23 Choose the appropriate number for each item to rate your FEAR OF PAIN in relation to each event: Getting a paper cut on your finger. DF24 Choose the appropriate number for each item to rate your FEAR OF PAIN in relation to each event: Receiving an injection in your mouth. DF25 Choose the appropriate number for each item to rate your FEAR OF PAIN in relation to each event: Getting strong soap in both your eyes while bathing or showering. DF26 Choose the appropriate number for each item to rate your FEAR OF PAIN in relation to each event: Having someone slam a heavy car door on your hand. DF27 Choose the appropriate number for each item to rate your FEAR OF PAIN in relation to each event: Gulping a hot drink before it has cooled. DF28 Choose the appropriate number for each item to rate your FEAR OF PAIN in relation to each event: Receiving an injection in your hip/buttocks. DF29 Choose the appropriate number for each item to rate your FEAR OF PAIN in relation to each event: Falling down a flight of concrete stairs. dfs_1 DF01 Has fear of dental work ever caused you to put off making an appointment? dfs_10 DF10 Please rate how much fear, anxiety, or unpleasantness each of these dental situations causes you: Sitting in the waiting room. dfs_11 DF11 Please rate how much fear, anxiety, or unpleasantness each of these dental situations causes you: Being seated in the dental chair. dfs_12 DF12 Please rate how much fear, anxiety, or unpleasantness each of these dental situations causes you: The smell of the dentist's office. dfs_13 DF13 Please rate how much fear, anxiety, or unpleasantness each of these dental situations causes you: Seeing the dentist walk in. dfs_14 DF14 Please rate how much fear, anxiety, or unpleasantness each of these dental situations causes you: Seeing the anesthetic needle. dfs_15 DF15 Please rate how much fear, anxiety, or unpleasantness each of these dental situations causes you: Feeling the needle injected. dfs_16 DF16 Please rate how much fear, anxiety, or unpleasantness each of these dental situations causes you: Seeing the drill. dfs_17 DF17 Please rate how much fear, anxiety, or unpleasantness each of these dental situations causes you: Hearing the drill. dfs_18 DF18 Please rate how much fear, anxiety, or unpleasantness each of these dental situations causes you: Feeling the vibrations of the drill. dfs_19 DF19 Please rate how much fear, anxiety, or unpleasantness each of these dental situations causes you: Having your teeth cleaned. dfs_2 DF02 Has fear of dental work ever caused you to cancel or not appear for an appointment? dfs_20 DF20 Please rate how much fear, anxiety, or unpleasantness each of these dental situations causes you: All things considered, how fearful are you of having dental work done? dfs_3 DF03 When having dental work done, my muscles become tense. dfs_4 DF04 When having dental work done, my breathing rate increases. dfs_5 DF05 When having dental work done, I perspire. dfs_6 DF06 When having dental work done, I feel nauseated and sick to my stomach. dfs_7 DF07 When having dental work done, my heart beats faster. dfs_8 DF08 Please rate how much fear, anxiety, or unpleasantness each of these dental situations causes you: Making an appointment for dentistry. dfs_9 DF09 Please rate how much fear, anxiety, or unpleasantness each of these dental situations causes you: Approching the dentist's office. Ethnicity Hispanic or Latino FearOfMedical Sum of responses related to fear of pain resulting from a medical procedure, including DF22, DF24, and DF28. FearOfMinorPain Sum of responses related to fear of minor pain, including DF23, DF25, and DF27. FearOfPainScore Total score of all Fear of Pain items, including DF21 through DF29. FearOfSeverePain Sum of responses related to fear of severe pain, including DF21, DF26, and DF29. FearOfSpecificDentalStimuli Sum of responses related to fear of specific dental stimuli, including DF14, DF15, DF16, DF17, DF18, and DF19. Participant_ID The participant's study ID. Pedigree_name The Family pedigree number assigned by genetic relationship. PhysiologicalArousal Sum of responses related to physiological arousal, including DF03, DF04, DF05, DF06, and DF07. Sex The particpant's sex Site The code for the study site where the assessment was given. TotalDFSScore Total score of all DFS items, including DF01 through DF20. Enumerations Enumeration Description Types Type Description Subsets Subset Description

URI: https://w3id.org/OHD/DFA-study/idaf Name: idaf_schema Classes Class Description Slots Slot Description idaf_1_a (1a) I feel anxious shortly before going to the dentist. idaf_1_b (1b) I generally avoid going to the dentist because I find the experience unpleasant or distressing. idaf_1_c (1c) I get nervous or edgy about upcoming dental visits. idaf_1_d (1d) I think that something really bad would happen to me if I were to visit a dentist. idaf_1_e (1e) I feel afraid or fearful when visiting the dentist. idaf_1_f (1f) My heart beats faster when I go to the dentist. idaf_1_g (1g) I delay making appointments to go to the dentist. idaf_1_h (1h) I often think about all the things that might go wrong prior to going to the dentist. idaf_2_a (2a) Going to the dentist is actively avoided or else endured with intense fear or anxiety idaf_2_b (2b) My fear of going to the dentist has been present for at least 6 month idaf_2_c (2c) My fear, anxiety or avoidance of going to the dentist significantly affects my life in some way (dental pain, avoiding eating some foods, embarrassed or self-conscious about appearance of teeth or mouth, etc.) idaf_2_d (2d) I am afraid of going to the dentist because I am concerned I may have a panic attack (abrupt fear with sweating, pounding liteart, fear of dying or losing control, chest pain etc.) idaf_2_e (2e) I am afraid of going to the dentist because I am generally highly self-conscious or concerned about being watched or judged in social situations. idaf_3_a (3a) Painful or uncomfortable procedures idaf_3_b (3b) Feeling embarrassed or ashamed idaf_3_c (3c) Not being in control of what is happening idaf_3_d (3d) Feeling sick, queasy or disgusted idaf_3_e (3e) Numbness caused by the anesthetic idaf_3_f (3f) Not knowing what the dentist is going to do idaf_3_g (3g) The cost of dental treatment idaf_3_h (3h) Needles or injections idaf_3_i (3i) Gagging or choking idaf_3_j (3j) Having an unsympathetic or unkind dentist dfs10 Please rate how much fear, anxiety, or unpleasantness each of these dental situations causes you: Sitting in the waiting room. dfs11 Please rate how much fear, anxiety, or unpleasantness each of these dental situations causes you: Being seated in the dental chair. dfs12 Please rate how much fear, anxiety, or unpleasantness each of these dental situations causes you: The smell of the dentist's office. dfs13 Please rate how much fear, anxiety, or unpleasantness each of these dental situations causes you: Seeing the dentist walk in. dfs14 Please rate how much fear, anxiety, or unpleasantness each of these dental situations causes you: Seeing the anesthetic needle. dfs15 Please rate how much fear, anxiety, or unpleasantness each of these dental situations causes you: Feeling the needle injected. dfs16 Please rate how much fear, anxiety, or unpleasantness each of these dental situations causes you: Seeing the drill. dfs17 Please rate how much fear, anxiety, or unpleasantness each of these dental situations causes you: Hearing the drill. dfs18 Please rate how much fear, anxiety, or unpleasantness each of these dental situations causes you: Feeling the vibrations of the drill. dfs19 Please rate how much fear, anxiety, or unpleasantness each of these dental situations causes you: Having your teeth cleaned. dfs2 Has fear of dental work ever caused you to cancel or not appear for an appointment? dfs20 Please rate how much fear, anxiety, or unpleasantness each of these dental situations causes you: All things considered, how fearful are you of having dental work done? dfs3 When having dental work done, my muscles become tense. dfs4 When having dental work done, my breathing rate increases. dfs5 When having dental work done, I perspire. dfs6 When having dental work done, I feel nauseated and sick to my stomach. dfs7 When having dental work done, my heart beats faster. dfs8 Please rate how much fear, anxiety, or unpleasantness each of these dental situations causes you: Making an appointment for dentistry. dfs9 Please rate how much fear, anxiety, or unpleasantness each of these dental situations causes you: Approching the dentist's office. dfs_avoidance_fear Sum dfs items 1, 2, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13. dfs_flag The participant have dfs value or not. dfs_physiological_arousal Sum dfs items 3, 4, 5, 6, 7. dfs_specific_stimuli_fear Sum dfs items 14, 15, 16, 17, 18, 19. dfs_total Sum all 20 dfs items. Ethnicity The participant's ethnicity is Hispanic. idaf1a (1a) I feel anxious shortly before going to the dentist. idaf1b (1b) I generally avoid going to the dentist because I find the experience unpleasant or distressing. idaf1c (1c) I get nervous or edgy about upcoming dental visits. idaf1d (1d) I think that something really bad would happen to me if I were to visit a dentist. idaf1e (1e) I feel afraid or fearful when visiting the dentist. idaf1f (1f) My heart beats faster when I go to the dentist. idaf1g (1g) I delay making appointments to go to the dentist. idaf1h (1h) I often think about all the things that might go wrong prior to going to the dentist. idaf2a (2a) Going to the dentist is actively avoided or else endured with intense fear or anxiety idaf2b (2b) My fear of going to the dentist has been present for at least 6 month idaf2c (2c) My fear, anxiety or avoidance of going to the dentist significantly affects my life in some way (dental pain, avoiding eating some foods, embarrassed or self-conscious about appearance of teeth or mouth, etc.) idaf2d (2d) I am afraid of going to the dentist because I am concerned I may have a panic attack (abrupt fear with sweating, pounding liteart, fear of dying or losing control, chest pain etc.) idaf2e (2e) I am afraid of going to the dentist because I am generally highly self-conscious or concerned about being watched or judged in social situations. idaf3a (3a) Painful or uncomfortable procedures idaf3b (3b) Feeling embarrassed or ashamed idaf3c (3c) Not being in control of what is happening idaf3d (3d) Feeling sick, queasy or disgusted idaf3e (3e) Numbness caused by the anesthetic idaf3f (3f) Not knowing what the dentist is going to do idaf3g (3g) The cost of dental treatment idaf3h (3h) Needles or injections idaf3i (3i) Gagging or choking idaf3j (3j) Having an unsympathetic or unkind dentist idaf_flag The participant have idaf value or not. Last_Dental_Visit How long has it been since you last visited a dentist or dental clinic for any reason? mdas1 If you went to the dentist for treatment tomorrow [How would you feel in the following scenarios?] mdas2 If you were sitting in the waiting room (waiting for treatment) [How would you feel in the following scenarios?] mdas3 If you were about to have a tooth drilled [How would you feel in the following scenarios?] mdas4 If you were about to have your teeth scaled and polished [How would you feel in the following scenarios?] mdas5 If you were about to have a local anesthetic injection in your gum above an upper back tooth [How would you feel in the following scenarios?] mdas_flag The participant have mdas value or not.
